popCulture.title: Golden Fleece
popCulture.description: Athamas' household is the fleece's origin: the golden ram that saved Phrixus from the king's madness still begins every Argonaut story.

popCulture.title: Athamas
popCulture.description: Athamas endures as the king Hera drove mad — the father who hunts his own children and seeds the voyage for the fleece.
